text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa! The ornament!
Espo-san, are you hurt!?
Did you drop it on your foot?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I haven't, but...
More importantly, this... gold dragon figurine...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can bump into things by accident! Don't worry about it!
More importantly, let's hurry up and clean this up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I ran into Copano Rickey
and Espoir City on their way to go shopping—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm going to look for a "golden ornament"
to decorate my new room with! Wanna come, Trainer?
You should put one in your room too!
choice_data_list: Yeah, then I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, what gives? Golden ornaments are
surprisingly hard to come by...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yellow works too, you know!
Isn't that chick figurine over there super cute too?
choice_data_list: It really does look easy to place!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, that ain't it.
Let's head to another place."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I seeee...
Well, we want something we're both happy with, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gold, golden... dragon...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray, Es-po-san♪
I'm sure you'll find it, it's bound to come true♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gahh! Shut up!!
And what the heck did you bring that for?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It didn't cheer you up? Aww! But look, it's cheering merch, and it's pretty! Having it near you is bound to give you energy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a collab item with Falco-san, after all.
Don't you think displaying it adds some flair?
choice_data_list: Maybe it'll shine brightly on us?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm gonna check out another store.
You guys go on ahead without me."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, Espo-san!
Could it be, you're looking for the exact same figurine?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame it broke... but don't worry about it!
Even if it's not the exact same item, as long as
it meets the requirements, the feng shui will still work――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't know anything about feng shui.
And I don't believe in it either.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? B-But!
You always take my feng shui advice, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's because you keep dumping it on me!
...Though—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san! I'll put this gold ornament right here!
Since it's a color that symbolizes "wealth" and "prosperity,"
good luck will surely come your way too, Espo-san☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Can't shake off your fatigue lately? Leave it to me!
I'll make sure you get a totally sound sleep☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...It's important to you, right? Like I'd know!!
Breaking it would just leave a bad taste in my mouth!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san...
Ehehe...
choice_data_list: Why don't we all search for a new "precious thing" together?
Shall we all look for a new "precious thing" together?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It doesn't have to be the same!
We're not looking for a replacement for what was broken!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm sure I can find something that brings even more good luck—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Ah!? Aahh--?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san!
Right now, you're glowing in a gorgeous gold!
choice_data_list: Ah, the setting sun reflecting off your hair...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! Oh, I see!
No wonder I felt so super happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The "gold" that brings happiness to you, Espo-san!
I had already found it all along~~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah~~!?
You, making things up on the fly again...!
choice_data_list: I can't really decorate it or anything, but...
Well, well, they seem satisfied themselves anyway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah~~!?
You, making things up on the fly again...!
choice_data_list: I can't really decorate it or anything, but...
Well, well, they seem satisfied themselves anyway.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we were just meant to be roommates!?
Hey, let's rearrange our beds and desks when we get back!
I'll let you have the west side, Espo!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No way, what a pain.
...Just give me whatever.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: She's totally right! I'm always moving around after all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sure thing!
The happy effect is already kicking in, after all... right?☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Not you being half-assed too, Trainer!
What is wrong with you guys?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We wanna make everyone happy!
We're the Happy-Lucky Rickey pair☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, heheh.
Isn't that right...?
